Scheduling & dispatch tools for Landscapers

Tools that help landscapers with scheduling & dispatch. Booking jobs, routing crews, managing calendars and reducing no-shows.

Where Scheduling & dispatch goes wrong for Landscapers

Route density decides profit in landscaping — two properties on the same street are worth more than one twice as far away. Crews routed badly lose an hour a day to driving.

What Landscapers jobs really involve

Landscaping runs on repeat visits and route density — the same properties, week after week. Scheduling and routing matter more than almost anything else, and most customers are happy to pay by card on the day.

Frequently asked questions

Which scheduling & dispatch tools work best for landscapers?

The three that fit best here are Housecall Pro (Home service businesses that want one app covering booking through to payment), Jobber (Owner-operators and small crews moving off paper and spreadsheets), Workiz (Small teams that live on the phone and want calls tied to jobs). Start with the one whose description matches your crew size, not the one with the longest feature list.

How much does scheduling & dispatch software cost for landscapers?

Across the 3 tools on this page, 1 have a free tier and the rest are paid, most of them billed per user per month. Prices change often, so treat the figures here as indicative and confirm on the vendor site.

Why does scheduling & dispatch cause problems for landscapers specifically?

Route density decides profit in landscaping — two properties on the same street are worth more than one twice as far away. Crews routed badly lose an hour a day to driving.

Is per-visit or monthly billing better for landscaping?

Monthly billing suits recurring maintenance because it matches how customers budget. Per-visit works better for one-off cleanups and seasonal work where the scope changes each time.
